how learners repair function vs acquire new structure during training | FRT/FAT joint admissibility theory + Qwen2.5-32B implementation (protected head repair, LoRA renewal, replay); coordinated policy wins all four comparisons

costly evaluation of every self-rewrite candidate | frozen linear readout on parent solve rate + 8 diff coordinates + Thompson-sampled archive; GPT-4o 87.0% held-out HumanEval+ vs 84.2% parent-rate ablation

reward hacking in realistic settings incl. tool calls and long contexts | dynamic intervention on steering directions (difference-in-means, gradient, spec-derived); coding-derived vectors generalize cross-domain at low capability cost

responses drifting from task-relative value profiles | density-gated selective decoding with changed-position and cumulative-KL budgets; boundary TPR .58 to .72 at .12 intervention; decode-time value steering, not an RL post-training dynamic

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: mutually inconsistent math / solver-code / report artifacts in LLM optimization pipelines | typed SMT semantic relation checks + certified repair; 3,034 problems: model-code match 43.2% to 88.2%, beats ReLoop and Opt-Verifier on refuted outputs

reference-conditioned teacher trajectories poorly suited for student learning | TeachBack bidirectional preference objective shaping the teacher + improves student over OPSD baselines on mathematical and logical reasoning

fragmented NPU compilation leaving avoidable execution overhead | GPU-compilation-evidence-guided agentic rewrites + iterative profiling; 1.7x average speedup over 4 workloads incl. LLM pretraining, ~2.0x over 27 Modded-NanoGPT records
